title: AMPBase v3 image family
description: The build matrix for the cubecoders/amp3base image family, and the list AMP3 reads to learn which images exist. One file serves both so that a tag cannot be built but unlisted, or listed but unbuilt. Entries are in BUILD ORDER: an image's "from" must appear earlier in the file than the image itself. Rules the schema cannot express (unique names across tags and aliases, that ordering, Dockerfiles that exist) are checked by build-images.sh.

schemaVersion.description: Format version. AMP3 keeps its last good copy rather than reading a version it does not understand, so this only changes when a reader would otherwise misinterpret the file.

repository.description: The repository every image in this file is published under.

replaces.description: Repositories this family supersedes tag for tag. A template or a migrated instance naming <repository>:<tag> from this list is given <this repository>:<tag> instead, provided the tag exists here or in "retired". AMP2's cubecoders/ampbase is the reason this exists.

images.description: Every image the family builds, in build order.

retired.description: Tags a superseded repository published and no longer maintains, mapped to the nearest tag this family still builds. Honoured only under a repository listed in "replaces": nothing of this family was ever called these.

refused.description: Tags of a superseded repository that have NO equivalent here and never will. Naming one is refused outright rather than mapped to something that cannot work.

tag.description: An image tag. Lower case only, so a tag has exactly one spelling.

repository.description: A Docker Hub style repository name without a registry host, e.g. cubecoders/amp3base.

tag.description: The canonical tag. This is the name a spire pulls, whatever name the template used.

aliases.description: Floating names published for the same image (java for java-lts, latest for debian). Resolved to the canonical tag before pulling, so a spire never holds one image under two names.

description.description: One sentence for humans: the README table and any UI that lists images.

dockerfile.description: Path of the Dockerfile, relative to this file's directory, which is also the build context.

from.description: The tag in THIS family the Dockerfile builds FROM, passed to it as the AMPBASE build arg so a build against a rehearsal registry follows the repository it was given. Absent or null means the Dockerfile names an outside base image itself (the distro bases).

platforms.description: Where the image is published. A spire on an architecture not listed here cannot run the image, and a multi-arch push builds exactly these.

args.description: Build args that distinguish this tag from the others its Dockerfile produces. Names as the Dockerfile declares them; values are strings even when they look like numbers or lists.

internal.description: Published for other images to build FROM, not for templates to name. Pulling it is not an error, but nothing offers it.
